title: DirectoryReadRequest
description: The input of directory.read: the users or the groups of the caller's own company's copy, all of them, one by its id, or those one search finds, as a directory asks after a conflict (step 43c's README, the real check, F5). It names its company as rate.load does, and line ② refuses any other: the caller's own, which the SCIM door writes from the token. This tutorial's own schema.

company.description: The call's own company, dsor://org_456/tenant/org_456, as rate.load names it. The SCIM door writes it from the company its token names, never from the request: line ② refuses any other company (DSOR-TEN-02b; step 43c's README, decision D3).
